aixventures-perplexity-ai:ashbyhq:8a9768.description: We build and run the inference engine behind every Perplexity query and deploy dozens of model architectures at scale with tight latency and cost budgets. This is the first silicon and system designed from the ground up for AI and the increase in radix and throughput unlocks greater GPU utilization to speed training job completion times and tokens-per-second for more profitable inference. Eridu has also assembled a world class IP, design and manufacturing ecosystem to execute on its vision, and counts TSMC as a key partner in our journey. These hardware designs incorporate high-speed optical and electrical I/O, processing and management components and will require careful consideration of power, cooling, reliability and overall cost. Your responsibilities will span from hardware definition to design, qualification and product release. To deliver these systems, you will need to collaborate with architecture, semiconductor, software and manufacturing team members and external partners. This is an exciting, hands-on design position that will require your creativity and attention to detail.
